location_note: Kh. Ka'kul (Pisgat Ze'ev H), printed NIG 22370-90/63565-95 (first full number used). Installations and tombs have their own NIG references (pp. 47-59); they lie within about 1 km and are grouped by class and dating status with the references in the subtype.
notes: Early Roman farmsteads and a Crusader-Mamluk village. Second Temple dates for the rock-cut installations of Areas A, B1, B2 rest on plaster type and context (the author's argument, pp. 9, 15). Winepresses: the author suggests a Hasmonean/Herodian date for the simple presses (hedged; A4 rule). Limekilns, terraces, watchtower and the 'bathing installation' of Room 615 are not eligible. Seven burial caves dug in 1993 (Kogan-Zehavi 1995) and tombs west of the site (Shurkin 2004) are cited only.
